feat: update capability editor fields (#66)

## Summary
- switch capability `template` editing from a single-line input to a textarea
- add the requested old/new icon asset fields with built-in preview support
- add searchable multi-select tag loading backed by `/api/v1/app/universal/tag/list`
- widen the capability editor dialog and allow icon fields to render side by side

## Why
- DAM-72 requires the capability add/edit form to match the backend contract and the legacy icon field set
- operators need live tag lookup while still submitting the backend comma-separated string format
- the expanded field set needs a wider layout to avoid an unnecessarily long form

## Validation
- pnpm --dir theaceae run check:camellia
